# LMP Dashboard

> Real-time and day-ahead locational marginal prices for NYISO, PJM, CAISO, and SPP: energy, congestion, and loss components, plus fuel mix, gas, weather, and storage context.

Part of [Kardashev Labs](https://kardashevlabs.org).

## What it shows

- RT and DA LMP at major hubs
- ~5-minute RT refresh
- Fuel mix, load, Henry Hub gas, weather, curtailment, reserve margins, battery context where available

## Terms

- **LMP**: wholesale $/MWh at a location (energy + congestion + losses)
- **DART**: day-ahead minus real-time at a node
- **Congestion component**: the part of LMP from transmission constraints
